baseline: CockroachDB v23.2-era self-hosted Enterprise observable capabilities
later_track: Newer Enterprise capabilities; exact successor release pinned when a slice is scoped
spec_approval: No feature specification is approved by this planning register

features.name: PostgreSQL protocol and SQL transactions
features.acceptance_summary: Driver matrix; transaction retry and ambiguous outcome histories; catalog and error compatibility.
features.notes: Enterprise comparison includes shared core behavior; not every row is Enterprise-exclusive.

features.name: Per-range replication and failover
features.acceptance_summary: Majority/minority faults, restart, split/merge and durable data invariants on multiple nodes.

features.name: Row-level TTL
features.acceptance_summary: Expiration, batching, restart, cancellation and no early deletion.
features.notes: Do not classify TTL as missing just because older comments call it CCL.

features.name: SQL IMPORT data loading
features.acceptance_summary: Type coverage, import failures, job re-adoption and exact restored values.
features.notes: One successful CSV case is not the entire IMPORT contract.

features.name: Full logical backup and restore
features.acceptance_summary: Exact-value/schema round trips; interrupted export; restore refuses before destructive work.
features.notes: Useful substitute; not native BACKUP/RESTORE SQL or Enterprise artifact compatibility.

features.name: Native backup and restore SQL/job lifecycle
features.acceptance_summary: Authorized SQL contract, durable progress, retries, cancel/resume and backup/restore conformance.
features.notes: Native job integration is an intermediate milestone; final native SQL semantics need separate acceptance.

features.name: Incremental backup chains
features.acceptance_summary: Changes, deletes, schema changes, chain validation, interrupted layers and bounded retention.
features.notes: Repeated full snapshots or updated_at polling are not equivalent.

features.name: Revision-history point-in-time recovery
features.acceptance_summary: Restore specified times across writes/deletes/DDL; reject gaps and times outside retained history.

features.name: Scheduled backups and retention
features.acceptance_summary: Overlap, retry, failover, timezone, secrets, protected chains and safe expiry.
features.notes: Existing CLI lock and old-copy pruning do not establish a native schedule service or backup-chain retention.

features.name: Encrypted backup artifacts and key lifecycle
features.acceptance_summary: Authenticated tamper detection, wrong-key refusal, recovery/rotation and no plaintext secrets.
features.notes: S3 server-side encryption is present; client-side artifact encryption and passphrase/KMS semantics are separate gaps.

features.name: Locality-aware backup destinations
features.acceptance_summary: Route execution and destination according to declared localities; measure failure behavior.
features.notes: A single client writing S3 is not distributed locality-aware execution.

features.name: Whole-cluster operational recovery
features.acceptance_summary: Explicit scope for principals, privileges, schedules, settings and recovery exclusions.
features.notes: Current logical tool skips system state/passwords and treats some administrative replay as warnings.

features.name: Durable changefeeds to external sinks
features.acceptance_summary: Initial snapshot plus changes/deletes, resume tokens, duplicates, ordering and schema events.

features.name: Changefeed resolved progress and recovery
features.acceptance_summary: No omitted changes across restart, splits and merges; declared ordering/checkpoint semantics.
features.notes: An OSS rangefeed substrate is not a complete user-facing changefeed.

features.name: Physical cluster replication and cutover
features.acceptance_summary: Consistent bootstrap, catchup, cutover, loss budget, failback and target crash recovery.
features.notes: v23.2-era capability; later GA status must not be backdated. #24 fixes hook dispatch only.

features.name: Multi-region table locality and survival policies
features.acceptance_summary: Observable region/locality DDL; placement; declared survival and residency under region faults.
features.notes: Raft's existence and node locality flags do not establish Enterprise multi-region policy semantics.

features.name: Follower-read and bounded-staleness behavior
features.acceptance_summary: Actual serving replica, timestamp safety, failover and latency evidence.
features.notes: Historical reads alone do not prove reads were served by a follower.

features.name: Native store encryption and rotation
features.acceptance_summary: Crash-safe rotation, restart, lost-key behavior, logs/temp/WAL coverage and recovery.
features.notes: TLS, S3 SSE and filesystem encryption are different guarantees.

features.name: Role-based SQL audit policy
features.acceptance_summary: Policy matching, role changes, redaction, failure policy and tamper-aware delivery.
features.notes: Existing structured event logs are not equivalent to role-scoped SQL audit policies.

features.name: SQL JWT/enterprise identity integration
features.acceptance_summary: Identity/key rotation, expiry, issuer/audience, tenant/role mapping and refusal tests.
features.notes: Inventory TLS/password/certificate support before treating all authentication as missing.

features.name: Procedures, UDFs and isolation-level coverage
features.acceptance_summary: Construct-by-construct SQL and isolation tests; annotate inherited/unsupported cases.
features.notes: Do not assume all PL/pgSQL behavior is absent or all 23.2 preview behavior is complete.

features.name: Diagnostics and workload observability
features.acceptance_summary: Compare named metrics, labels, privilege, retention and overhead requirements.
features.notes: Separate self-hosted software behavior from vendor-operated monitoring services.

features.name: Logical cross-cluster replication
features.acceptance_summary: Bootstrap/change stream, deletes, loop prevention, conflict policy and convergence.
features.notes: Later capability, separate from v23.2 physical replication and not a baseline completion dependency.

features.name: Native row-level security policies
features.acceptance_summary: Default deny, role policy combinations, writes, views, prepared plans, backup and CDC boundaries.
features.notes: A client-side filtering proxy is not native security parity.

features.name: Vector type and distributed similarity indexes
features.acceptance_summary: Exact distance oracle, dimensions/types, recall@k, concurrent mutations, faults and upgrades.
features.notes: Separate exact search, approximate indexes, pgvector API coverage and distributed performance.

change_log.change: Initial public-documentation and permitted-source comparison; current upstream licensing FAQ is unsuitable as a historical feature-entitlement snapshot; no parity row promoted.
